_comment: Phase 7 ability registry. Default Super Metroid ability set. Each entry's params are read by Player physics hooks via AbilityDef.ParamFloat/ParamInt — packs can retune (e.g. easier mode with high_jump multiplier 1.6 instead of 1.4) without code edits.

abilities.name: Morph Ball
abilities.description: Curl into a ball. Press down to enter morph; smaller hitbox lets you fit in 1-tile gaps.

abilities.name: Space Jump
abilities.description: Re-jump in mid-air after a spin jump apex. Effectively infinite jumps.

abilities.name: Screw Attack
abilities.description: Spin jumps damage enemies on contact and break screw blocks.

abilities.name: Speed Booster
abilities.description: Run for 1 second to enter shine state. Run faster, plow through soft blocks.

abilities.name: Shinespark
abilities.description: While shining, crouch then jump in any direction for a damaging dash.

abilities.name: Wall Jump
abilities.description: Jump off walls during a wall slide.

abilities.name: Grappling Beam
abilities.description: Latch onto grapple blocks and swing across gaps.

abilities.name: Ice Beam
abilities.description: Beams freeze enemies into temporary platforms.

abilities.name: Wave Beam
abilities.description: Beams travel in a sinusoidal pattern and pass through walls.

abilities.name: Double Jump
abilities.description: Jump a second time in mid-air.
